name: claude-code-session-monitor
description: Monitor Claude Code and Codex sessions together: live state, attention, limits, provider-aware actions, CPU/RAM, and honest usage data.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces the auto-resume settings (resumePrompt, resumeAutoType, autoResumeAfterReset) are ignored, so a workspace cannot make the extension type text into your editor.

commands.title: Agent Sessions: Resume Session in Terminal
Agent Sessions: Resume All Claude Sessions (staggered)
Agent Sessions: Stop Claude Resume Sweep
Agent Sessions: Set Model for All Claude Sessions…
Agent Sessions: Set Effort for All Claude Sessions…
Agent Sessions: Forget Other Claude Accounts (delete stored tokens)

claudeSessionMonitor.enableClaude.description: Show and monitor Claude Code sessions.

claudeSessionMonitor.enableCodex.description: Show and monitor Codex sessions through the official local Codex app-server.

claudeSessionMonitor.codexExecutable.markdownDescription: Codex CLI executable used to launch the local official app-server. Use an absolute path when `codex` is not available on VS Code's `PATH`.

claudeSessionMonitor.codexPollSeconds.description: How often to refresh Codex thread and account-usage metadata from the local app-server, in seconds.

claudeSessionMonitor.notifyOnWaiting.description: Notify when a session starts waiting for permission/input.

claudeSessionMonitor.notifyOnLimited.description: Notify when a session hits a session/rate limit.

claudeSessionMonitor.notifyOnDone.description: Notify when a session finishes its turn (your turn).

claudeSessionMonitor.usagePollSeconds.description: How often to refresh official account usage limits from Anthropic, in seconds. The poll is shared across ALL VS Code windows (single-flight through a snapshot file), and a 429 triggers an exponential backoff every window honors.

claudeSessionMonitor.trackAllAccounts.markdownDescription: Remember every Claude account you log into (identity in `~/.claude/session-monitor/accounts.json`, access token in VS Code Secret Storage, i.e. your OS keychain) and keep fetching usage for non-active accounts in the background, so the Usage limits panel can show each account and switch between them. Turn off to track only the current login; run **Agent Sessions: Forget Other Claude Accounts** to also delete already-stored tokens.

claudeSessionMonitor.planLabels.markdownDescription: Plan label shown on each usage card, keyed by Claude account email, or `claude` / `codex` for the provider card. Example: `{ "me@example.com": "$200 Max", "codex": "$100 Pro Lite" }`. When a key is missing the label is derived from the login's rate-limit tier (Claude keychain `rateLimitTier`, Codex `planType`) and left blank if unknown.

claudeSessionMonitor.usageWarnPercent.description: Warn (toast + native notification) when any Claude usage gauge (5h, 7d, per-model) reaches this percent. 0 disables.

claudeSessionMonitor.recentScanMaxAgeHou.description: Show sessions that were active within the last N hours.

claudeSessionMonitor.showEnded.description: Show ended (closed) sessions. Off by default: when a session's tab is closed it is removed from the list.

claudeSessionMonitor.hideEndedAfterMinut.description: When showEnded is on, hide ended sessions older than this (minutes).

claudeSessionMonitor.workspaceOnly.description: Only show sessions belonging to this VS Code workspace.

claudeSessionMonitor.nativeNotifications.description: Show a native macOS notification on limit/waiting transitions (even when VS Code is not focused).

claudeSessionMonitor.stuckAlertMinutes.description: Alert when a working session stays silent this many minutes (0 = off).

claudeSessionMonitor.cpuHogThreshold.description: Sessions above this CPU% are flagged with a flame icon.

claudeSessionMonitor.resumeStaggerSecond.description: Seconds between Claude sessions during a staggered resume sweep (avoids hitting the rate limit by resuming all at once).

claudeSessionMonitor.commandStaggerSecon.description: Seconds between Claude sessions when sweeping a slash command like /model or /effort into every open Claude session.

claudeSessionMonitor.resumeAutoType.description: Auto-type the resume prompt and press Enter via macOS keystrokes (needs Accessibility permission for VS Code). If off, the sweep just focuses each session and you press Enter.

claudeSessionMonitor.resumePrompt.description: Text typed into each Claude session during a resume sweep.

claudeSessionMonitor.autoResumeAfterRese.description: When Claude sessions hit the usage limit (or the Claude 5h window is at 99%+), automatically run the staggered resume sweep ~90s after the window resets.

claudeSessionMonitor.idleRamWarnMb.description: Warn when idle sessions (waiting / your-turn, silent >1h) together hold more than this much RAM (MB). 0 disables.
